limitations_and_boundaries: No evaluation of P. merdae DPP4-like enzymes in mice not treated with LPS; expected no differences in incretin cleavage as per Wang et al. in control diet mice.
No changes in blood glucose and insulin levels observed, possibly due to lag between incretin release and glucose metabolism effects.
Study focused on Parabacteroides and Porphyromonas; other bacterial DPP4-like enzymes not extensively characterized.
In vivo experiments used LPS-induced gut barrier disruption; results may not generalize to other models of gut barrier dysfunction.

methods.name: Metagenomic analysis
methods.protocol_description: GLMM with covariate controls (age, sex, BMI) to evaluate differential abundance of DPP4-like genes in T2D patients; sPLS-DA with four-fold cross-validation to quantify classification power. All tests in R v4.1.2.

methods.name: In vitro enzymatic assay
methods.protocol_description: Recombinant pmDPP4 and pmDPP4Δ23 expressed in E. coli BL21-DE3; cell-free supernatants tested for GLP-1 cleavage via MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry; synthetic dipeptide Gly-Pro p-nitroanilide (gpPNA) used as substrate; LDH activity measured to control for cell lysis.

methods.name: Animal experiment
methods.protocol_description: LPS-treated mice with impaired gut barrier; oral Ensure Plus load; portal vein blood sampling at 15 min with/without DPP4 inhibitor; plasma and cecal content collected; active/total GLP-1, total GIP, PYY, insulin, proglucagon measured by Luminex; active GIP by ELISA; glycemia by colorimetric kit; DPP4 activity measured in plasma, cecal content, and feces.

methods.name: Statistical analysis
methods.protocol_description: Shapiro-Wilk normality test; t-test or Wilcoxon-rank sum test for in vitro and animal data; GLMM with covariates for metagenomic differential abundance; sPLS-DA with four-fold cross-validation. R v4.1.2, ggplot2, GraphPad v9.
